steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Here are all the case files the Eastside Public Security Bureau has handed over this time. Please review them, Chief.
test
test
test
test
test
test
Are they all unsolved missing person cases?
You flip through these case files that are from different times and handled by different people.
Aside from the victims all being young and beautiful women, there seems to be no commonality among these cases...

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Correct. That's why the Eastside Public Security Bureau didn't combine these missing person cases in the past.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Some of the cases are even considered non-criminal. The files are only kept because the people who reported them have never come to close them.
Some of these files are indeed very thin and contain only the reporter's statement and the missing person's photo, providing very little information.
The girls' radiant beauty makes them shine in the either nicely printed or worn-out photos, but that was also what attracted covetous eyes.
Yet the truth is that they indeed became prey in someone's eyes. They didn't just run away due to their own petulance or unbearable abuse.
If only this evidence... hadn't appeared in such a bizarre form.
In the most recent case file, there's a perfume tester strip sealed in a plastic bag and labeled Rose.
The perfume it was once soaked in has long faded away. Even if you try hard to perceive it, you can only sense a faint trace of Mania in it and nothing more.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Although these cases have remained unsolved, there has been a recent breakthrough. This perfume tester strip here.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: It was accidentally discovered by a victim's sister at a perfume gala. The Public Security Bureau has confirmed the remaining personalized perfumes from the catalog of perfumes distributed to the participants and compared them with the missing person case files.
Is there no way to get different perfume samples of a bigger size?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Regretfully, these personalized perfumes are very popular among the rich in Eastside now, and they are only sold at special perfume galas in individual packaging. No one is willing to resell them.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: However, the Public Security Bureau has obtained an invitation to a perfume gala. The case is related to Sinners, so you might need to attend it personally.
test
test
test
test

She hands you a beautifully crafted invitation. It specifies the location and time of the perfume gala, but there's no signature. Only a faint fragrance lingers on the paper, hinting at the identity of the host. A skilled perfumer.
Is the FAC's assessment result consistent with that of the Eastside Public Security Bureau?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Yes. Although the personalized perfumes are considered important clues, the Public Security Bureau has been unable to ascertain the real identity of the perfume gala host.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The FAC also believes there is a high possibility of a Sinner's involvement in this case, and that it should be handed over to the MBCC.
The ongoing missing person cases, the personalized perfumes related to Mania, and the mysterious perfumer... Indeed, this is a peculiar case that you can't just ignore.
Got it. I will look for more clues at the gala. I'm leaving the back-end support to you, Nightingale.

Top notes: 
rosemary, Damask rose, pink pepper
In the opulent venue of the gala, expensive, richly fragrant perfumes are displayed everywhere, and a generous amount of tester strips are available for every item.
The carefully designed spacing ensures that different perfumes won't interfere with each other during testing while filling every corner of the venue with a faint fragrance.

You stand in a position overlooking the whole venue and observe the luxurious figures in the hall. The rich young ladies stroll gracefully in this venue free of vice and ugliness, all looking lithe and elegant.
But the affluent middle-aged ladies who hold even more power and wealth are not interested in these expensive perfumes. They seem to be waiting for a different exhibit, some grand finale of the gala.

steps.speaker: Young Lady A
steps.content: What a rich and full-bodied fragrance! I'm dying to know what's the raw material behind such a luscious rose note. Though I also found that citrus note over there very fresh and exquisite. Auntie, do you think my pocket money is enough to buy them all?

steps.speaker: Rich Woman B
steps.content: Haha, you're a greedy young lady, sweetheart. But don't get carried away, those are not our target today.

steps.speaker: Young Lady A
steps.content: Do you mean that perfume that's supposed to grant you eternal youth, as written in the catalog? I thought that was just a tagline.

steps.speaker: Rich Woman B
steps.content: You know nothing. Look at these celebrities and heiresses here, do you think they can be fooled by just a regular perfume? I've heard about that lady who successfully bid for the perfume last time. She's got the skin of a young girl again...
A perfume that grants you eternal youth...? It's probably related to Mania too.
Finding the perfumer means finding the answer to everything, whether it's the connection between the missing person cases and the perfume, or the source of the Mania ingredient in the perfume.
You don't believe the perfumer who actively uses perfume to create buzz will miss such a grand occasion. He or she is definitely in this crowd, watching for an opportunity.
Thinking of how to catch that mysterious perfumer among the crowd?
While you are lost in thought, a stranger is pushed by the crowd to your back. His casual whisper in your ear makes you tense up instinctively.
Relax. I know you're here to investigate the missing person cases, Chief of the MBCC.

...Investigate the missing person cases? Maybe you should call the police instead. Take the exit, turn right, and you'll find the Public Security Bureau. Don't waste your time striking up a conversation with strangers here.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Chief ${PlayerName}, you are making it so obvious... My name is Lucas, I'm sort of an investigative journalist. Now, I'm looking into this missing person case, just like you.
...How did you recognize me?

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Well, I've got my own sources, being in this line of work. I know this case has been handed over to you guys at the MBCC. I've been researching and asking around to try to keep up with you guys... Luckily, I've bumped into you.

The serial disappearances can be traced back to many years ago, but the cases have only become connected and have been investigated collectively recently. The clue concerning this perfume is also only circulating within a small circle.
Unless one is closely following the leads, it's impossible to catch up with the MBCC's operations so easily...
You can't expect me to believe everything you say without any evidence. You need to prove that you're not just a gossip columnist trying to probe for information.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: A gossip columnist couldn't have made it this far. After all, even the Eastside Public Security Bureau has almost given up on these missing cases that don't bring them any profit or publicity.
So many women have disappeared and have probably even died. And all you care about is profit and publicity?

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Even in Eastside, it's not unusual for beautiful girls from the lower classes to suddenly disappear.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Some are tricked by shady intermediaries into underground businesses, some can't bear the poverty and grasp at the wrong lifeline, and some choose to spend their nights in entertainment facilities...

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Even if such a case is filed, there's a lower than 30% chance it'll ever be solved. There's no profit in either investigating or reporting it. And why would anyone pay attention to such a mundane incident?
The man in front of you looks dejected, his tone unsurprised and almost emotionless.
But somehow you feel that this isn't lofty indifference, but rather disregard resulting from longtime frustration.
You've said it's neither profitable nor newsworthy, and investigating it is a waste of effort. Then why are you doing this?

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: What else can I do? I gotta do something about my daughter.
You mentally search for the victims' photos from the files and try to compare their facial features with this haggard face worn out by time and agony before you, but come up empty.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Don't even bother, Chief. My daughter has been missing for a long time. Those useless sheriffs probably have already lost her file.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: At first, we were a whole investigative group. Then some people gave up, and now only four or five of us are still persisting.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Finally, I found a clue from a luxury product seller. The names of those perfumes. Anna, Marilyn, and so on... The other parents' daughters were all in there, except mine.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Some of us thought there must be some kind of connection, and some thought it was a mere coincidence. So I attended three perfume galas, went through all the catalogs, and brought back a few tester strips.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: They all fell ill after smelling their daughters' scents. How strange that they could recognize their daughters with just a sniff of the perfume even though they hadn't seen them for so many years. And me? I can't even find my daughter's scent.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: I can only tell myself that no news is good news... This could mean she's still alive and hasn't been harmed. I can still hope...
Seeing the anxiety, sadness, and agony in the desperate father, you can't help but sigh.
I understand your desperation, but there's a hint of Mania in those personalized perfumes. This suggests that the perfumer may very well be a Sinner.

It's too dangerous for an ordinary person like you to go after a suspected Sinner. Before you can save your daughter, you may get entangled in it yourself. Please don't be reckless and trust that the MBCC will give you an answer.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: No, no, no. YOU should trust me. You've only been on the missing cases for a matter of days while it's been six years for me! I've still got a lot of exclusive leads that the Public Security Bureau wouldn't take but are absolutely reliable...

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: I can help you. Trust me, I can help you find that perfumer! As long as you can save my daughter...
Obviously, you can't take an ordinary person along for the investigation, but it's also impossible to completely get rid of him for now.
Just as you're racking your brains on how to deal with Lucas, you smell a unique fragrance. Even without any professional knowledge about perfume, you can tell the hazy scent is of premium quality.

You can't identify the specific ingredients, but the scent is elusive and incredibly light, as if it's cleansing the dust of time accumulated in your veins. Even Lucas pauses the conversation to get immersed in the scent.
Instinctively, you know that this is a sign of danger, but you can't determine the source of the scent... until the shackles send a warning.
A reaction... to special power... A Sinner?!
You leave Lucas at once and hastily follow the shackles' directions to the source of the special power. But Lucas refuses to give up and follows closely behind you.
You're not sure if you've imagined it, but the closer you get to the source, the more the hazy scent in the air intensifies... The source of the scent is also the source of the special power.
...It's still not perfect yet. The fruity scent is too catchy and bubbly, and lacks poise... It's clean enough though. Let me add this...
In a corner hidden by tall decorations, a young woman is mumbling to a sleeping beauty in her arms.

They seem incredibly intimate, but when the young woman points the perfume bottle at the beauty in her arms and is about to press the atomizer, the shackles suddenly start to pulsate wildly, signaling a warning.
The fragrance quietly floating in the air at the venue is also enlivened with the woman's action. It seems to roll into a torrent and rush toward the woman... No, toward that beauty in her arms.
She is without a doubt using the perfume bottle to activate her special ability. The beauty's breathing is gradually weakening. If this continues, she may suffer irreversible damage!
Let her go!
Yes?
Distracted by you, the Sinner lifts her head. In her lifeless burgundy eyes, you see your own reflection, along with a hint of surprise that surfaces on her otherwise calm demeanor.
You seize the chance, pull the girl from her arms, and toss her to Lucas who's followed you here.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: So you're the perfumer...!
Protecting the victim in his arms, Lucas confronts the young woman, glaring at her with bloodshot eyes.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Tell me, why did you name your perfumes after those girls? Do you know them? What do you know? Were you the abductor?!
Calm down, Lucas!
In that tense moment, you can't afford to hesitate. You grab the perfumer's wrist that's still holding the perfume bottle and activate the shackles.
A red glow spreads out and sinks into the young woman's ivory-white skin before retracting.
You succeeded. Almost instantly, you gain restraint over this unknown Sinner through the shackles. But just to be safe, you swiftly snatch that perilous perfume bottle from her hand.
What a shame...
To your surprise, at the moment of her capture, what she expresses is not resentment, anger, complacency, or boastfulness, but rather regret. The regret of gaining something just to lose it again.
Give it back to me.
She calmly demands, her tone extremely matter-of-fact.
...What do you want?
My perfume, give it back. It's mine.
This is absurd. But from her severe, displeased expression, you realize that the perfume indeed matters to her way more than the shackles binding her.
You're now a Sinner detained by the MBCC. Your perfume bottle will be confiscated indefinitely as a medium of special power.
Of course, if you are cooperative and honest, I will consider helping you get it back as soon as possible.
The perfumer stays silent. You're not sure if this signifies a compromise or a silent protest.
To play safe, you gesture for the MBCC staff sent by Nightingale to put the bottle in an evidence bag and take it away.
...Yes, I believe she's the type that uses a medium to cast her special power. The danger is under control with the restraint. No need to send more people, I can bring her back to the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Understood. The transport vehicle is already waiting outside. Please be careful, Chief.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Wait, Chief...
Lucas, who has been standing by, steps forward. He's visibly calmer now, but his eyes are still burning with a desperate hope.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Eleanor

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: At least... at least help me find out where my daughter is. The worst thing you can get is one extra clue... right?

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: Okay, I'll be waiting for your good news...
From the inner pocket of his coat, he pulls out a faded photo still warm with his body temperature. He hesitates for a moment, but still hands it to you.

steps.speaker: Lucas
steps.content: This is the best photo I have of her... I'm entrusting it to you.
You nod solemnly and carefully stow it away.
The perfumer maintains her long silence on the side, her expression cold, as if she's detached herself from the situation.

Although she doesn't resist arrest violently, you don't feel any more at ease. After establishing a connection through the shackles, you feel as if a bottomless, glacial black hole sits on the other end.
The mental state of this Sinner is obviously way more problematic than you thought. The upcoming interrogation... probably won't be easy.
